Choose a 3 × 3 area centered on a point within 5 squares. Call divine energy. The area becomes the Fold until the end of your next turn. You and each ally in the Fold gain 1 Boon to all rolls. The Fold does not move. As a Maneuver on a later turn, you can sustain the Fold until the end of your next turn. Sustaining costs the Maneuver and requires you to be able to act.
